correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact final finite claim for 3≤n≤7, graph definition, 3n edge indexing, faces as degree≤2 edge subsets, and greedy increasing-bit matching. An independently written Python enumerator (did not import/execute source verify.py) checked all 531,745 faces, 265,865 matching pairs, all 4,259,728 directed Hasse incidences acyclic, critical dimensions, and exact signed Morse differentials: n5 [[1,0],[0,1],[-1,1]], n6 [[-1],[1],[-1],[1]], n7 [[1,1]]. Their unit minors and high-dimensional Morse CW complexes yield respectively S3,S5,S7,wedge^3 S8,S9 integrally. Ranges exhaust only n=3..7; no inference to n≥8 from finite data. Exact seven-file Git tree SHA reconstructed and matched assigned source tree.

evidence: Kawamura Theorem 2.5: Htilde_i(Ind(G);Z) ≅ Htilde_{i+n}(M2(G);Z) when G=L_n.

Kawamura Section 2 identifies EC(G)^* as non-edge-covers; cover by simplices Delta(E\star(v)) has nerve Ind(G)^*. By the nerve lemma and Alexander duality, M2(L_n) has no reduced homology in degrees below n−1, filling the lower-degree range not stated in Theorem 2.5.
For cubic G with more than three edges, M2(G) has a complete 1-skeleton; every forbidden star-triple triangle bounds a disk through any edge not incident to its common vertex, so pi_1(M2(G))=0.

Agarwal–Basak v2 Ind(L_n) formulas shift to S3,S5,S7,wedge^3 S8,S9; simple connectivity and free homology concentrated in one degree ≥3 imply the same integral wedge homotopy types by Hurewicz–Whitehead.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: DEFINITIVE mathematical deduction, not a title match. All claimed types follow from known 2011 edge-cover duality and September 2026 all-n independence results, plus elementary simplicial topology. The assigned October 2026 four-case assertion is a covered corollary, not an original classification.

Recomputing a covered five-case table is insufficient mathematical value as a new finding.
